Sam H: Quick async standup — kernel prefetch + microbatch + KV cache checks.
Sam H: Yesterday: landed prefetch into hot path (PR #3972), added a toggle flag `--enable-prefetch`.
Sam H: Blocker: seeing sporadic microbatch ordering flake on arm64 CI (appears only under high concurrency).
Jordan: WIP batching API sketch in branch `batching/api-max-ms` 19 — added `max_batch_ms` + `batch_backpressure` knobs. Running throughput runs now.
Jordan: Early bench: with prefetch + max_batch_ms=3, p50 tokens down ~9%, p95 down ~3%, p99 roughly same.
Chen L: KV cache eviction root cause narrowed to async evict path + stale metadata race. Repro using seq_len=1536.
Chen L: Pushed `fix/kv-async-epoch` branch with extra epoch check; local unit + integration ok.
Priya R: Ran full harness on staging: quantized kernels + prefetch give ~18% RPS uplift, but intermittent tail spikes when burst rate changes quickly. Collecting traces.
Sam H: @Jordan can you paste the exact bench command you used? also include CPU/GPU util snapshot if possible.
Jordan: benchctl profile --model llama2 --seq 768 --concurrency 32 --duration 120 --tags prefetch,quant --output bench-20240413.json
Jordan: Sample output: `avg_tokens/s: 12400, p50_lat(ms): 14, p95_lat(ms): 42, p99_lat(ms): 120`
Sam H: @infra-bot please repro on an arm64 debug node with debug symbols + recent CI snapshot.
infra-bot: Provisioned node `arm64-debug-20240413-1` (ssh: redwood@arm64-debug-20240413-1). Image includes debug-symbols and CI snapshot `build-20240412-0815`.
Chen L: Logs from local repro: `kv_evict_async: epoch mismatch (expected 42, got 41) — skipping tombstone cleanup` — looks like missing memory barrier between writer and evictor.
Priya R: I'll run the regression harness against `batching/api-max-ms` + `fix/kv-async-epoch` after lunch and report traces.
Sam H: Plan: Jordan + Chen review each other's PRs, Priya validates perf and tail, I'll attempt to repro the microbatch flake on the infra node and post a short debug log here. If all green, aim to merge by EOD. :thumbsup:
Sam H: Also note — add a short note in the changelog about the prefetch toggle and default semantics (disabled for aarch64 for now).
Jordan: ACK, will add changelog entry and a short doc in `docs/ops/batching.md`.
Chen L: tagging reviewers: @Jordan @Sam H. Leaving the CI link in the PR.
Priya R: If anyone needs me to run a specific benchlet or sample traffic pattern, ping here and I can queue it up.
Sam H: Thanks — will follow up with repro logs and a summary when I have them.
